Name: Museum Store
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Adds (most) museum rewards to a shop at the museum, after you've earned them. Adds furniture rewards to the furniture catalogue.
Description:
This mod just adds collected rewards to a shop in the museum. By default, it's one tile to the right of Gunther, although it can be moved simply by relocating the tile property [font=Courier New]Action: atravita.MuseumShop[/font]. It also adds furniture rewards to the furniture catalogue. Also, by popular demand, it lets you trash items you got from the museum. (Note that this isn't retroactive - you would have to had picked up the item from the museum with this mod active.)

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Configuration
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to configure.

The single configuration option [font=Courier New]BoxLocation[/font] lets you set the location the box will spawn.

Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Probably fine for a single player to install in multiplayer.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods.
Note: this mod looks at the [font=Courier New]museumCollectedReward[/font] mail flags to generate the list of items to sell; if another mod adds a museum reward (and adds the flag), it'll also be sold by this mod. As far as I know, that's currently zero other mods.

See also

*   [Changelog](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/MuseumRewardsIn/MuseumRewardsIn/docs/Changelog.md)

*   [Source Code](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/MuseumRewardsIn/MuseumRewardsIn)
